propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table contains only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL is us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8, leaving the default unguarded against temperature rejection.
Both us.* and global.* Bedrock model ID prefixes reject temperature and top_p parameters on the opus family, but the override table keys on full model IDs without matching both prefixes.

The table entry omits the bare model IDs claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7, which are used on the Anthropic adapter path and cause silent parameter dropping and loss of determinism on code-review Pass-2.

Temperature parameter value 1.0 (the API default) succeeds on opus models while explicit 0.0 and 0.5 fail, indicating the rejection is of tunability rather than support; the field name supports_temperature misdescribes the actual mechanism.
Code-review Pass-2 pins temperature=0 for determinism but all passes run on claude-opus-4-8 which silently drops the parameter, causing nondeterminism in production review verification.
The top_p parameter is also deprecated on opus models but has no corresponding supports_top_p override; this is latent but confirmed via CloudTrail as a real server-side rejection.
